         **Review examples:**
            1. _C M_, Aug 22, 2026, 1/5: "DEFINITELY DO NOT RECCOMEND!!! ## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 19, 2026 - Aug 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Melissa Audirsch_, Aug 19, 2026, 1/5: "Do not download this app! It is not a real company, they will take your money, charge you a monthly subscription fee, and when you try to cancel it they will give you the run around and tell you that they can't find your account and you will not be able to cancel your subscription. STAY AWAY!!!!!"
            2. _B “Ilovetacos” R_, Aug 21, 2026, 4/5: "The app itself is great. It is just too expensive for my budget. When I did have a problem figuring part of it out, Kate Brown in the support area was quick to respond, had everything I needed all in one conversation. No need for multiple back and forths. Overall it's a great app and the workouts are easy to follow, well explained and adaptable."
            3. _Karen Rosenberg_, Aug 21, 2026, 5/5: "Although this program is expensive, it does help get you moving. However, because of the expense I will not be renewing my subscription. Sorry."
<!--/ir-theme-->
